ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-J in the
area bound by:

South Central Park Avenue; a line 48 feet north of and parallel to West 16" Street; the
alley next west of and parallel to South Trumbull Avenue; a line 50 feet north of and
parallel to West 16" Street; South Trumbull Avenue; a line 63 feet north of and parallel to
West 16" Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Homan Avenue; a line 48
feet north of and parallel to West 16" Street; South Homan Avenue; line 50 feet south of
and parallel to West 16" Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Homan
Avenue; line 60 feet south of and parallel to West 16" Street; South Trumbull Avenue;
line 50 feet south of and parallel to West 16" Street; South Drake Avenue; and a line 52
feet south of and parallel to West 16" Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passag Je and publication.

Wal

Moniqte L. Sto
Alderwoman, Sard

Common Address:
3400 - 3550 W. 16" Street
